source_summary: Tall monochrome Chinese landscape scroll with layered misty mountains, steep ravines, textured rocky ridges, tree clusters, bridges, village architecture, water surfaces, and small scholar figures in the lower foreground. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif selection.

motifs.name: misty_back_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large pale rounded mountain mass in the upper center-right background, rising behind the darker foreground ridges. Include only the soft ink-wash silhouette, faint horizontal and arcing contour strokes, and mist-softened edges.
must_preserve: empty atmospheric gaps around the peak

motifs.name: left_needle_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow steep cliff on the upper left, with a pointed vertical mass, shaggy ink texture, and small dark tree dots along its crest and slopes. Avoid nearby calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: dark dotted shrubs along ridge edge
soft grey wash on rounded lower slope

motifs.name: upper_right_rocky_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the dense upper-right rocky ridge with overlapping rounded boulders, stippled vegetation, and darker ink accents cascading down the slope. Exclude any red seal impressions on or near the ridge.

motifs.name: central_mist_ravine
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow central ravine running downward between the left and right mountains, including the pale mist-filled void, vertical dark vegetation seams, and descending rock walls on both sides.

motifs.name: mid_slope_bamboo_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-level zigzag bamboo or wooden bridge and stepped path crossing a rocky ledge, with bundled rail lines and nearby small shrubs. Include the immediate rock platform but not the larger surrounding mountains.
must_preserve: closely spaced plank or bamboo linework

motifs.name: right_pine_grove_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the dense pine and tree grove on the right middle slope, including tall straight trunks, dark needle clusters, pale trunks, and the curved mountain wash behind them where it directly supports the grove.

motifs.name: lower_village_courtyard
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left village compound with tiled roofs, open pavilion-like room, fenced bank, and rippling water in front. Include the small seated figure visible inside the building and the immediate waterside setting.
must_preserve: open central room with tiny seated figure

motifs.name: foreground_bridge_figures_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the bottom foreground scene with the small round waterside pavilion, footbridge, winding stream, and tiny scholar-attendant figures crossing near the bridge. Include the adjacent low banks and immediate tree roots only.
must_preserve: small walking figures with distinct heads and robes
dark foreground bank dots and root-like strokes

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
